text: Get back over to the Eastside, you hop head!

text: If you don't know, you probably shouldn't be here.  This is the Heights.  Mister Hightower lives here and he only sees people on appointment.

text: Can I set up an appointement with Mr. Hightower?

text: I don't like your attitude.  You'd better leave.

text: After sundown nobody is allowed in this area.  The other guards won't even give you a warning.  If they catch you they'll attack.  You'd better get back downtown while your head is still attached to your neck.
